rationale: Bounded lookup now fits the measured catalog sizes, and the same writer and public job interface integrate in actual host storage.
Former false absence, revocation/refill, stale selector and denied current miss invariants have focused negative tests, plus failures observed in actual inference.
Public selection, miss handling, migration and queue integration are traceable in separate responsibilities with runnable example.
Current query path drops language/title branches and speculative retrieval; candidate and approval modules now have separate duties.
Adds defect-detecting tests for known misses, queue/settlement interactions and archived live scale and held-out cases to the existing boundary suite.
Measured bottleneck and bounded lookup fixed; actual-cloud approval path remains below 3s at tested sizes.
Actual host queue and store can complete, cancel and reopen with recorded wiring and negative receipt checks; package consumers pass.
Demonstrated catalog growth under structurally mixed registrations without losing those measured fast-path goals.
